scope: Optional player-approved quality suggestion only. Default/stored quality, lighting source, geometry, mechanisms, DPR and render scheduling remain unchanged. Local integration artifact, not a release.

detection.meaning: Observed spacing of foreground continuous animation callbacks, not GPU execution time or measured render cost.
detection.threshold: Three consecutive sample windows, each at least 800 ms and eight callbacks, each with at least 75% intervals longer than 40 ms. Healthy windows reset the slow-window streak.
detection.shortAnimationReason: presentation.ts normally uses 650-2200 ms non-dice beats, so valid windows may accumulate across short animation bursts. Demand callbacks and the first always callback after demand are never samples.
detection.expiry: Reset after 10 seconds without a valid always sample or 30 seconds since the evidence window began.
detection.interruptions: Mount/scope/enabled changes settle for 3 seconds. Blur/focus/visibility/window or visual-viewport resize or changed canvas dimensions/DPR clear evidence and settle for 2 seconds. Invalid, nonpositive or greater-than-200-ms deltas clear evidence and settle for 2 seconds. Hidden, unfocused, economy, reduced motion, paused, loading or unavailable WebGL scenes cannot suggest.
detection.originalRegression: The unchanged real-source AdaptiveQuality test replays 90 demand callbacks at 50 ms, with no slow classification and no automatic quality change. New monitor tests also exclude 10 Hz demand.

interaction.recordedWhen: First actual display, before any choice. Refusal, close, ignore, refresh, reconnect and later rounds do not repeat. With denied storage, module memory prevents repetition within the same page only.
interaction.onlyWriter: The explicit lower-quality button calls the existing App setLowQuality(true); existing App persistence remains unchanged.
interaction.dismissal: 12 seconds, decline, close, foreground loss, resize, critical choice/dice/intro/ability UI, menu opening, low-motion/economy selection or scene unavailability. Never changes quality on dismissal.
interaction.layout: Bounded-width child of the measured HUD, no modal, backdrop, focus grab or absolute/fixed overlay. Viewports shorter than 600 px omit this optional prompt; the normal menu quality control remains available.

officialBrowserDomFixture.method: Actual QualitySuggestion component/hook and complete game CSS with the actual HUD measurement hook; representative HUD, camera, minimap, status, dice and board-action DOM. Callback deliberately supplied by a QA button. This is not the complete game or a WebGL performance test.
verifiedActions: Mobile lower button sets low-quality state true
Previously shown hint stays absent after fixture reload
Board action remains clickable while hint is shown
Dice button remains clickable and critical-action state removes hint
limitations: No real iOS/Android device or mobile browser engine exercised
No complete-game WebGL or device FPS certification

The long desktop inspection reached a no-write result for the lower button; timeout/dismissed-handler protection was not instrumented. A fresh short mobile interaction verified explicit acceptance. Desktop geometry, not desktop acceptance timing, is certified here.
officialBrowserDomFixture.previewCleanup: sites-preview stop and status both confirmed stopped

verificationLimits: Builds emit the existing greater-than-500-kB chunk warning
Local Chromium launch was blocked by sandbox sockets; it was not retried with changed security flags. Official-browser DOM testing completed instead.

Conservative false-negative boundary: if a detected but not yet shown suggestion is cancelled by focus loss or a shallow viewport, that mounted monitor does not retry. A future scene remount may monitor again if no hint was ever displayed. This avoids intrusive repeated prompting.
The final visualViewport keyboard guard was covered by actual-source callbacks and hook interaction tests, not a real on-screen mobile keyboard.
